$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0921-array-integer2-csdn.xml, transcribed element by element from the XML bytes - NOT produced by e142DocumentToJson (Rule 10, D-030). The richest overlay fixture in the corpus and the negative case for Task 11. Covers: MapType=Array carried as ONE string rather than an array of rows; MapType ABSENT on the second overlay, where no XSD default exists and the prose default 2DArray applies - one BinCode is then one ROW of 20 tokens against a 5x4 lattice, which is where E142_XML_DIM_MISMATCH comes from; MapName with NO MapVersion, so the OverlayKey version is "" and the member is omitted rather than written empty; an Overlay carrying NO map at all, because OverlayType's xs:choice is optional; and two SubstrateMap entries sharing a SubstrateId with different LayoutSpecifier, which is schema-legal. The XML writes its attributes in scrambled order (MapType before NullBin before BinType) - order is meaningless in both formats, which is why this transcription does not preserve it.
